# Constant `pill_editor_shell::shell::views::SCENE_BADGE_SHADOW_ALPHA`

```rust
pub const SCENE_BADGE_SHADOW_ALPHA: f32 = 0.22;
```

Source: `editor\pill_editor_shell\src\shell\views.rs:59`

The opacity of one shadow sample. The shadow draws the mark once per
sample of [`SCENE_BADGE_SHADOW_SAMPLES`](constant.SCENE_BADGE_SHADOW_SAMPLES.md#rustdoc-item-394), so the copies add up in the
middle and thin out at the rim.
